description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license and a slim .gitignore. src/global.json is optional and unchecked by default. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another WinForms app to the same repository.

Where this app's .slnx is written. Default src/sln/{name}/ with the handbook beside that file. Other locations: repository root (src/sln/{name}/ stays as notes), or src/prj/{name}/ next to the WinForms app csproj (slnx and handbook; no src/sln/{name}/). Several .slnx files in the same folder make `dotnet` require an explicit path (MSB1011). Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the template solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Used only on publish. Default is self-contained single-file with ReadyToRun and compression. The other recipes match the WPF template set.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the WinForms app, tests, and benchmark. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Which cohesive WinForms sample to copy. Basic is the default Form1 skeleton. GenericHost adds Generic Host, DI, logging, configuration, and English/German/Spanish/French/Italian/Portuguese/Simplified-Chinese localization. Matching tests and the optional benchmark come with the same choice.

Default is This app (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later apps keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the WinForms app project.

Optional DocShell.html seed. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another app unless you only want to skip docs. Bootstrap and mini docs are a checkpoint task.
Default MIT. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license when that first-create item is selected.

name.text: Code style rules for WinForms app project

description.text: Single choice. Default is Strict: naming, nullable, and reserved identifiers (CA1716) fail the build. Default (style suggestions) is the same dump without those errors. Off writes no file. Test and benchmark projects are not affected.
SDK CA rules on the WinForms app only. Default Recommended. Minimum is fewer warnings. All is almost every CA rule. Separate from code style Strict.

Single choice. Default is Coverlet: dotnet test fails below 100% line, branch, and method coverage on the WinForms app. Edit Threshold in the test csproj if you want less. Coverlet and ReportGenerator also writes HTML/Markdown. None writes no extra test packages. ReportGenerator needs Coverlet output, so the two are not independent checkboxes.

Default off. Writes empty Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets beside this WinForms app, and Directory.Solution.props and Directory.Solution.targets beside this app's .slnx. Landing files for extra MSBuild. Tests and benchmark are not affected. No Directory.Packages.props.

Default on. Writes an empty .config/dotnet-tools.json beside this WinForms app (no tools). Landing file for dotnet tool install --local. Uncheck to skip. Tests and benchmark are not affected. Does not restore tools on build.
